item.title: BTS, Olivia Rodrigo, Jack White & More: Which Is Your Favorite New Music Release This Week? Vote!
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's New Music Friday on Billboard. I'm your host, and we've got a lot to dive into. Let's start with the biggest release of the week: Olivia Rodrigo's new album, 'You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love Day'. This is her third studio album, and it's already making waves with hits like 'Drop Dead' and 'The Cure'."
[Short music clip of "Drop Dead" plays]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo is known for her emotional journeys, and this album is no exception. She's collaborated with Dan Nigro and even brought in Robert Smith from The Cure for a standout track. But she's not the only one with new music out this week. Bebe Rexha and Infinity Song are also releasing new albums, 'Dirty Blonde' and their eponymous LP, respectively."
[Short music clip of Bebe Rexha's "New Religion" plays]
Host: "And that's just the beginning. We've also got new projects from Baauer, Blxst, Jessie Reyez, and many more. But let's switch gears to singles. BTS is celebrating their 13th anniversary with the release of 'Come Over', a deluxe vinyl-exclusive bonus track. And Jack White is giving us a taste of his new album with 'Dollar Bill'."
[Short music clip of BTS's "Come Over" plays]
Host: "We've also got new singles from Ayetian, Rapsody, Nipsey Hussle, and a collab between Tove Lo and Stromae. It's a packed week for music, and we want to know: what's your favorite new release? Cast your vote in our New Music Friday poll, and let us know what you're listening to."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this week's New Music Friday. We'll catch you next time with more music news and updates."
